text: What's my favorite golf club?
Whichever one I haven't thrown yet.
Why did my golf ball go left?
Because I aimed right. It always listens to the opposite.
What do you call a golfer with a perfect swing?
Someone I've never met.
Why is my slice so reliable?
It's the only part of my game that shows up every single time.
What's the hardest shot in golf?
The one right after you say, watch this.
Why did I buy new clubs?
So I'd have something new to blame.
What's my handicap?
Honesty, mostly.
Why do I always find the sand trap?
My ball loves the beach more than I do.
What did I shoot today?
I stopped counting when I ran out of fingers, and then toes.
What's the golfer's favorite kind of music?
Anything with a good swing to it.
What do you call it when you hit the ball straight?
An accident. A wonderful, unrepeatable accident.
What's the most-used word on a golf course?
Fore — followed by a lot of quieter words.
What's the difference between my golf ball and my car keys?
I can actually find my car keys.
Why was my drive so bad?
The wind, obviously. The wind that only exists when I swing.
What ruined my game today?
The course. They clearly moved the holes.
Why did I miss the easy shot?
A butterfly looked at me funny.
Why is the 19th hole everyone's favorite?
It's the only one nobody ever bogeys.
What did the golfer order after 18 holes?
Everything. It was a long, character-building day.
Why do golfers love the clubhouse?
It's where every terrible round becomes a great story.
How do you know someone loves golf?
Don't worry, they'll tell you. Then tell you again.
What's a golf widow?
Someone who married a person and a set of clubs.
Why did the golfer check the weather ten times?
He was praying, mostly.
What do golfers dream about?
That one perfect shot that keeps them coming back forever.
Why does a golfer play in the rain?
Because the course was open, and that's reason enough.
What did the golfer name his dog?
Birdie. It was the only one he could count on.
What's the best part of golf for a beginner?
Every single shot is a brand-new adventure.
Did you know golf teaches a lesson about the past?
You can't change the last swing — only the grip you take on the next one.
What does golf teach about mistakes?
Every round has a bad hole. Don't let one ruin the whole game.
Why do they say to play the ball where it lies?
In golf and in life, you start from where you actually are, not where you wish you were.
What's the wisest rule in golf?
The only shot that matters is the next one.
What does golf say about patience?
You can't force a good shot. You settle, you breathe, and you let it happen.
Why is honesty called the soul of golf?
You keep your own score — so the game is really a mirror of your character.
What does a missed putt teach you?
Shake it off and walk to the next hole. Life gives you another swing too.
Why do golfers say keep your head down?
Same as life — stay focused on what's in front of you, not the crowd.
What does golf teach about comparison?
You play your own ball. Somebody else's game is none of your business.
Why is the follow-through so important?
How you finish matters as much as how you start — on the course and off.
Why do they say golf is a game of misses?
Nobody hits it perfect. You just try to make your misses a little better each time.
Why do golfers replace their divots?
You leave a place better than you found it. That's just good living.
Why do golfers keep coming back after a bad day?
Because tomorrow's fairway doesn't remember today's slice.
Why do the seniors tee off early?
So they can nap with a clear conscience.
What's a mulligan?
A do-over — golf's gentle way of saying everybody deserves a second chance.
Why is a hole-in-one so special?
It's the one time the whole round goes exactly as you dreamed.
What did the golf ball say to the club?
See you around, hopefully in the right direction this time.
Why can't you play basketball with pigs?
They always hog the ball.
Why was the basketball court always wet?
The players kept dribbling.
What do you call a basketball player who misses every shot?
Consistent.
Why did the football coach go to the bank?
To get his quarterback.
Why did the football team go to the bakery?
They needed a good roll.
What has 18 legs and catches flies?
A baseball team.
Why did the soccer ball quit the team?
It was tired of being kicked around.
What lights up a soccer stadium?
A soccer match.
Why did the hockey player bring a broom?
For the sweep.
What do you call a polite hockey player?
Canadian.
Why was the hockey rink so quiet?
Everyone was on thin ice.
Why did the hockey puck go to school?
To stop getting slapped around.
Why is tennis such a loud sport?
Everyone raises a racket.
What do you call a tennis champion with a cold?
A real sneeze-ball.
Why are tennis players bad at relationships?
Love means nothing to them.
Why don't boxers tell jokes?
They always deliver a punchline too hard.
What do you call a boxer who loves gardening?
Someone who really knows how to plant one.
Why was the boxer so calm?
He knew how to roll with the punches.
Why did the swimmer bring a bar of soap?
In case he wanted to make a clean lap.
What swim stroke do sheep do best?
The baaa-ckstroke.
Why was the track star good at math?
He was always running the numbers.
Why did the bowling pins lie down?
They were on strike.
Why was the bowling alley so quiet?
You could hear a pin drop.
What do you call a bowler who tells jokes?
A real strike of genius.
Why did the bowling ball go to therapy?
It kept ending up in the gutter.
Why are bowlers so calm?
They know how to spare their feelings.
Why do cyclists make good storytellers?
They always put a spin on it.
What do you call a cyclist who won't pedal?
Stationary.
Why was the gymnast good at finances?
She was very flexible with her balance.
What's a golfer's favorite letter?
The tee.
Why is ping pong such a polite sport?
Everyone takes turns and says sorry.
Why did the ping pong ball get promoted?
It always bounced back.
What's the hardest position in sports?
The recliner, and I've mastered it.
What's a couch coach's specialty?
Perfect plays, three seconds after they happen.
Why did grandpa yell at the TV?
The players couldn't hear him, but tradition is tradition.
What's the best snack for watching sports?
Whatever's within arm's reach of the recliner.
Why do old-timers love the good old days of sports?
Everybody was faster, tougher, and uphill both ways.
What did grandpa say about modern athletes?
Talented, sure, but can they fix a fence?
What's the fastest sport?
Whichever one gets you to the snack table quickest.
Why did the scoreboard go to school?
It wanted to keep count.
What do you call a sport with no rules?
A family reunion.
What's the secret to any sport?
Show up, try hard, and blame the ref.
What's the fastest way to forget why you came upstairs?
Arrive upstairs.
Why did I open the fridge?
To ask it a question I've since forgotten.
Why did I go to the garage?
The garage knows. I don't.
Why did I come in here?
Ask me later. Much later.
What's my superpower?
Forgetting the plan between the couch and the kitchen.
What's harder than finding my glasses?
Finding them without my glasses.
Why was I calling my own phone?
To find the phone I was calling with. Details.
Where's my phone?
In my hand. Don't tell anyone.
Why did I panic about my phone?
I was using the flashlight on it to look for it.
What's more embarrassing than losing your phone?
Talking on it while you look for it.
Where did I leave my keys?
Somewhere so safe even I can't find them.
Why do I own three sets of keys?
So I can lose them in rotation.
Why is remembering names so hard?
My brain files them under 'later' and loses the folder.
How do I remember a name now?
I don't. I remember their dog's name perfectly, though.
Why did I read that page twice?
The first time was just a warm-up, apparently.
Now where was I?
That's the title of my autobiography.
Why did I stop talking mid-sentence?
The thought left without saying goodbye.
Why did I walk over here to tell you something?
And now we wait together.
What's worse than losing your train of thought?
Watching it leave the station without you.
Why did I go to the store for milk?
I came home with everything but milk.
What's the one thing I always forget at the store?
The list. It's on the counter, waving.
Why do I make a grocery list?
To leave at home as tradition demands.
What did I go to the store for?
Twelve dollars says it wasn't the forty dollars of stuff I bought.
Why did I go back to the store?
For the thing I went the first time for.
Where's my coffee?
In the microwave, where I reheat it four times daily.
Why did I microwave my coffee again?
Same reason as the last three times: I forgot it.
What did I do with my to-do list?
Added 'find the list' to a new list.
Why did I leave the room and come back empty-handed?
The errand and I parted ways in the hall.
Why is the remote in the bathroom?
Ask the person who put it there. Oh. That's me.
Where did I put my coffee cup?
It'll turn up. It always does. Usually cold.
Why did I set a reminder?
To remind me about the other reminder I ignored.
What's the point of a calendar?
To show me what I forgot in a very organized way.
Why did I write it on my hand?
So I could wash it off before reading it.
What did I come in here to do?
Great question. Riveting mystery. No answer.
Why do I open a new browser tab?
To forget what I opened the last twelve for.
What's my most-used phrase?
It'll come to me.
Why do I say 'it'll come to me'?
It rarely does, but hope is free.
When does the forgotten thought return?
The moment it's no longer useful.
Why did I laugh in the middle of the store?
I finally remembered the joke from this morning.
What's my brain's filing system?
Everything important goes under 'miscellaneous, good luck.'
Why is my memory like a sieve?
It keeps the song lyrics from 1975 and loses lunch.
What does my brain remember perfectly?
An embarrassing thing I did in the ninth grade.
Why can't I remember why I came here?
But I can sing every word of a jingle from decades ago.
What's my memory's specialty?
Total recall of the one thing I'd love to forget.
Why is my short-term memory so short?
It's more of a suggestion, really.
Why do I feel better after forgetting something?
Because you just admitted you do it too.
What's the secret club nobody remembers joining?
The 'why did I come in here' society.
How do you know you're in good company?
Everybody nods when you say 'now where was I.'
Why is forgetting so universal?
It's the one thing we all do and none of us remember doing.
Why shouldn't you worry about forgetting?
Half the room just did the exact same thing.
What's the last place I always look?
The place it was the whole time.
Why do I always forget where I parked?
The car moves when I'm not looking. That's my story.
Why did I start telling this joke?
And that, my friend, is the whole punchline.
Why couldn't the pony sing at church?
She was a little hoarse.
What did the rider say to her nervous horse?
Hay, settle down.
Why did the horse cross the arena?
To get to the other stride.
Why did the horse sit down at dinner?
He was told to hold his horses.
What do you call a horse that lives next door?
Your neigh-bor.
Why did the horse get a job?
He wanted a stable income.
Why don't horses gossip?
They'd rather keep it in the stable.
Why did the horse win the debate?
He had a strong mane point.
What's a cow's favorite subject?
Cow-culus.
Why did the cow cross the road?
To get to the udder side.
What do you call a sleeping bull?
A bulldozer.
What music do cows love?
Anything with a good moo-sic beat.
Why don't cows ever hurry?
They believe good things come to those who graze.
What's a cow's favorite holiday?
Moo Year's Day.
Why did the cow join the gym?
She wanted to work on her calves.
What did the little calf say when she was scared?
I want my mooo-mmy.
What do you call a pig that does karate?
A pork chop.
What's a pig's favorite ballet move?
The pork-de-bras.
Why did the pig become a chef?
He was great at bringing home the bacon.
What do you call a pig that tells jokes?
A ham.
Why was the little pig always so happy?
He was in hog heaven.
What did the pig say on a hot day?
I'm absolutely bacon out here.
Why don't pigs drive very well?
They always hog the road.
What do you call a pig that studies the sky?
He's just waiting for the day pigs fly.
Why did the pig sit in the shade?
He didn't want to be a hot dog.
What's a pig's favorite color?
Mahog-any.
Why did the chicken join the band?
She had the drumsticks.
What do you call a funny chicken?
A comedi-hen.
What did the egg say to the comedian chicken?
You crack me up.
Why did the hen bring a suitcase?
She was ready to fly the coop.
Why did the little chick get in trouble?
She used fowl language.
Why was the chicken good at baseball?
She kept hitting fowl balls.
What do you call a proud mother hen?
Egg-static.
Why did the fainting goat leave the party?
Someone yelled surprise.
What did the fainting goat say before the loud noise?
Nothing — he was already on the ground.
What do you call a goat that tells jokes?
A real kidder.
Why did the fainting goat avoid the marching band?
One cymbal crash and it's nap time.
What do you call a baby goat with a big imagination?
A kidder with kid dreams.
What's a goat's favorite kind of story?
One with a big cliff-hanger, which he can climb.
What did the goat say to the picky eater?
You don't know what you're missing — I'll eat anything.
Why was the fainting goat bad at surprises?
He always fell for them.
What do you call a sheep with no legs?
A cloud.
What's a sheep's favorite kind of music?
Anything with a good baaa-lad.
Why did the sheep stay up late?
She couldn't stop counting herself.
What do you call a sheep covered in chocolate?
A candy baaa-r.
What's a sheep's favorite dessert?
A baaa-nana split.
Why did the sheep cross the road?
To get to the baaa-ber shop.
What do you call a sheep that karate-chops?
A lamb chop.
Why did the duck get a bill?
He forgot to pay for lunch.
What do you call a duck that tells jokes?
A wise-quacker.
Why did the duck cross the road?
To prove he wasn't chicken.
What time does a duck wake up?
At the quack of dawn.
Why was the duck such a good doctor?
He had a great bill of health.
What's a duck's favorite snack?
Cheese and quackers.
What did one duck say to the other?
You quack me up.
Why did the donkey refuse to move?
He was just being his stubborn self.
What do you call a donkey with three legs?
A wonky donkey.
What's a donkey's favorite subject?
Hee-story.
